GREEN EMPIRE — Windows build
============================

The playable file GreenEmpire.exe belongs HERE (dist\GreenEmpire\).

It is NOT stored in the Git repository because the file is ~106 MB and GitHub
rejects any single file over 100 MB. The build is produced fresh from source
with one command (Godot 4.7.1 with Windows export templates installed):

    godot --headless --export-release "Windows Desktop" dist/GreenEmpire/GreenEmpire.exe

The result is a single self-contained executable (game data embedded, no
console window, application icon and version metadata set). Double-click it to
play — no installation, Godot, Python, or terminal required.

This exact build was produced and smoke-tested during development:
  - launches to the main menu,
  - New Game starts a playable campaign,
  - save / load round-trips,
  - the automated test suite passes against the exported binary.

See ../../README.md ("How to Play") and ../../docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md.
